name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately describes painting the cursor highlight + range-indicator sprite pattern. No address residue. Verified against decompile + both callers (battle frame compositor pipeline).
purpose: Paint the battle cursor highlight and weapon/spell range-indicator sprite pattern around the cursor world tile; the pattern shape is chosen by data_fd2_battle_anim_phase.
logic_summary: Loads cursor world (x,y). switch(data_fd2_battle_anim_phase): phase 1 blits cursor sprite 0 at (x,y); phase 2 blits sprite 1 at (x,y); phase 3 paints a 5-sprite manhattan-range-1 cross (sprites 0xe,2,3,4,5); phase 4 paints a 13-sprite manhattan-range-2 area; phase 5 paints a 21-sprite manhattan-range-3 area (uses sprites 1..0x12 across cardinals, range rings and inner diagonals); phase 6 clears the per-tile cursor flag by writing 0 to tile_map[(y*map_width_tiles+x)*4 + 7]. All blits go through fd2_blit_24x24_at_window_relative_pos which is window-bounds-clipped, so off-window x+-k/y+-k coords are silent no-ops.

returns.semantics: No return value; paints into the battle render workspace via the blit helper (or, for phase 6, mutates the tile map).

notes: Source comment block (rndscene.c lines 107-126) already precise: correct phase-by-phase summary, notes blit helper is bounds-clipped, references fdother cursor sprite atlas; matches decompile -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit needed, source file unchanged. Ghidra plate is the more detailed (per-sprite-coordinate) variant and is consistent with the source summary + decompile -> ghidra_plate_action=none. Decompile cases 4/5 fold their final blit into a shared goto (sprite_idx/uVar1/uVar2); source spells each blit out explicitly -- functionally identical (phase4 last = (x,y+1,0xd); phase5 last = (x+1,y+1,0x12)). writes_globals: phase 6 writes through the data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr base into the tile map array (clears tile cursor flag byte at offset 7 of the tile's 4-byte? -- actually *4 stride, +7), not the pointer variable itself. Two callers: fd2_composite_battle_frame @0x11cac and fd2_wait_input_with_status_panel_repaint @0x18b84 -- both the battle frame compositor pipeline, confirming the cursor/range-overlay role.
